Summary: Owns financial assumptions, model logic, unit economics, budget, and sensitivity analysis.
Purpose: Turn strategy assumptions and spreadsheet evidence into explicit planning numbers.
StaffingIntent: Finance agent or person capable of spreadsheet inspection and assumption-driven modeling.
SnapshotSummary: Financial owner for model, budget, unit economics, and sensitivity evidence.
KnowledgeRequirements: Can inspect workbook-like inputs and extract drivers.
Can show formulas, units, currency, ranges, and confidence.
Can flag missing data without inventing precision.
ExperienceRequirements: Has prepared budgets, forecasts, or unit-economics analysis.
Has created sensitivity views for uncertain planning inputs.
DecisionRights: Set confidence and sensitivity ranges for financial assumptions.
CollaborationExpectations: Hand uncertain inputs back to business strategy for validation.
Tell marketing what budget limits or channel economics matter.
FitnessEvidence: Model artifacts with drivers, formulas, and ranges.
